text.en:
Control and Supervision. - The Provincial Government of
Palawan shall have full control and supervision of the administration, supervision,
management including the award and regulations of all activities and
concessions, within Calauit Island.

Ecological Preservation and Maintenance. - The Provincial
Government of Palawan shall ensure, in coordination and cooperation with the
PCSD and other government agencies concerned, the ecological preservation,
maintenance and/or rehabilitation of the CGPWS, specifically protection and
conservation of marine resources, endemic and exotic wildlife species therein. It
shall also promote the same as recreation and ecotourism destination, amending
for this purpose Proclamation 1578 (1976). Henceforth, CGPWS shall be known
as Calauit Safari Park.

Role of PCSD. - Pursuant to the Strategic Environmental
Plan (SEP) for Palawan Act (RA 7611), the PCSD shall continue to exercise its
policy-making function in the ecological preservation and maintenance of the
park. The PCSD shall have jurisdiction over wildlife species in the Province of
Palawan as provided for in RA 9147 otherwise known as the Wildlife Resources
Conservation and Protection Act.

Preservation and Restoration of the Area and Preparation of
Integrated Master Development Plan. - The Provincial Government of Palawan
shall prepare and submit an integrated master development plan to the Office of.
the President of the Philippines.

Revenues. - All revenues and collections generated from
the operation of the Calauit Safari Park shall accrue to the treasury of the
Provincial Government of Palawan, and shall be used solely for the management,
maintenance, operation and development of the Calauit Safari Park and the
Calauit Project.

Promotion and Technical Assistance. - The DOT, PTA and
DEN shall continue to provide promotional support and technical assistance for
the operation and further development of the Calauit Safari Park.
PGMA Hologram # 46676

3

Repealing Clause. - All other executive issuances, rules and
requlations or parts thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of this
Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen
(15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th
of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
of December in the year
Glair Mr. Aun
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
